text:
Estimates per item (rough portion sizes from the photo):

- Cake slice: 80 g, 250 kcal
- Tortellini in tomato sauce: 150 g, 220 kcal
- Pot roast (shredded beef): 100 g, 220 kcal
- Potatoes (3 small): 150 g, 120 kcal
- Fruit salad: 150 g, 80 kcal
- Chicken stir-fry with rice: 350 g, 550 kcal
- Drink (cola, 200 g, ~85 kcal) and the bottle of brown liquid (about 60 g, 30 kcal): these are drinks, so I left them out of the food mass. I counted the cola's energy but not the bottle's.

Food mass: 80 + 150 + 100 + 150 + 150 + 350 = 980 g.
Food energy: 250 + 220 + 220 + 120 + 80 + 550 = 1440 kcal. Adding cola (~85 kcal) and the bottled drink (~30 kcal) gives about 1555 kcal. I rounded this to 1550 kcal, and added the two drinks' mass (about 260 g) to reach roughly 1240 g.

{"kcal": 1550, "mass_g": 1240}
